title: English Practice Quiz 0553
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: If I had more time, I ___ another language.
questions.explanation: The second conditional uses would + base verb for an unreal or imagined situation.

questions.question: They said, 'We have finished.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect commonly shifts to past perfect in reported speech.

questions.question: She is good at ___.
questions.explanation: A preposition such as at is followed by a noun or gerund.

questions.question: Listen! The baby ___.
questions.explanation: Listen! suggests an action happening now, so use the present continuous.

questions.question: If a task is 'urgent', it needs ___.
questions.explanation: Urgent means requiring immediate or prompt attention.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use there are with plural nouns.

questions.question: Read: 'Ravi practises English for twenty minutes every evening.' How long does he practise?
Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
questions.explanation: Start with a capital letter and use a question mark.

questions.question: If she studies, she ___ the test.
questions.explanation: Use will + base verb in the main clause of the first conditional.
